studies.eligibility_reason: Primary ERAP1 genetic perturbation in an experimental HLA-B27 spondyloarthritis model; transferable mechanism and bounded disease relevance.
studies.assessment_scope: Main-text methods and results; supplements not fully assessed

context.model: 33-3 transgenic HLA-B27/human beta2m, mixed Lewis/Sprague-Dawley background
context.blinding: Clinical caretakers blinded to genotype; colon histology scored by two blinded observers
context.randomization: Allocation randomization not reported in main text; discordant histology re-randomized for rescoring
context.statistics: Student t-test reported; p<0.05; multiple-testing correction not reported in main methods
limitations: Lifelong gene loss is not equivalent to adult pharmacological treatment
Peripheral arthritis, not direct evidence of axial clinical remission

claims.text: ERAP1-null HLA-B27 transgenic rats had lower arthritis frequency than ERAP1 wild-type rats in the reported cohort.
claims.locator: Results, Effects of ERAP1 deficiency on disease; Figure 4A; Supplemental Table 1 cited by main text

claims.text: Among rats developing arthritis, clinical severity and onset were reported as comparable between ERAP1-null and wild-type groups.
claims.locator: Results, Effects of ERAP1 deficiency on disease

claims.text: ERAP1 deficiency did not reduce stool-score abnormalities and colon histology scores were higher in the HLA-B27 transgenic model.
claims.locator: Results, Effects of ERAP1 deficiency on disease; Figure 4C

claims.text: ERAP1 deficiency increased cell-surface HLA-B27 disulfide-linked dimers while reducing misfolded HLA-B27 accumulation in whole-cell lysates.
ERAP1 deficiency did not restore impaired allogeneic T-cell stimulation or the depleted CD103-positive dendritic-cell population in the reported model.
ERAP1 deficiency reduced Il23a upregulation in IFNg-primed, LPS-stimulated HLA-B27-expressing macrophages.

impact.rationale: Supports bounded disease-model biology but contradicts a simple universal chain from reduced surface dimers to protection. Does not test compound engagement or chemical-genetic dependency.

studies.eligibility_reason: Primary transferable ERAP1 chemistry, structure and cellular pharmacology.
studies.assessment_scope: Main text; supplementary identity and assay details still required before measurement import

context.cell_readout: SIINFEKL presentation from precursor; functional readout, not direct occupancy
context.conflicts: Most authors current/former GSK employees as disclosed
limitations: Comparator pIC50 for compound 7 reported n=1

claims.text: Compound 1 inhibited recombinant ERAP1 but had no measurable cellular inhibitory activity in the reported antigen-presentation assay.
Compound 13 had reported enzyme pIC50 8.6 and cellular antigen-presentation pIC50 7.7.
Ligand-bound ERAP1 structures were reported for compounds 1, 2, 7 and 13 at the regulatory binding site.

impact.rationale: Updates chemical/structural landscape and documents biochemical-to-cellular discordance. Functional presentation does not independently establish occupancy or axSpA efficacy.

studies.eligibility_reason: Registered ERAP1-directed interventional axSpA study within search window; registration is not an efficacy result.

context.radiographic_status: Not restricted to radiographic AS in retrieved eligibility text
context.design_caveat: Top-level nonrandomized/open-label fields versus planned randomized double-blind Part D; preserve part-specific distinction

claims.text: EAST-1 is a registered phase I/II study of GRWD0715, described by the sponsor as an oral selective ERAP1 inhibitor, in healthy volunteers and axSpA participants.
The retrieved EAST-1 registry record has no posted results.
The registered biologically active dose definition permits a mean steady-state exposure threshold of 1166 ng/ml as one criterion based on predicted IC50 and related oncology PK-PD modelling.

impact.rationale: Establishes existence of axSpA clinical development, not demonstrated efficacy. Planned exposure/proxy criterion is not an observed direct engagement measurement. Baseline no-indexed-clinical-intervention language must not be reused as a completed-refresh finding.
